name: CubingUSA Western FMC Championship 2024
information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckJrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c731a0b8e384f56070122d87ed01eb98d2db634f/main.png)

- This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC)

- This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. 

- This competition exists to crown the Western Champion of FMC for 2024! For a more normal comeptition experience, or additional details, check out [CubingUSA Western Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSAWesternChampionship2024)

- Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at CubingUSA Western Championship 2024 during the award ceremony there.

- This competition will take place at different venues across Northern and Southern California. If you are potentially unable to reach these locales, we would highly recommend refraining from registering from this competition.

-  Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSAWesternFMCChampions2024#40693-locations) for more details.
